status: DRAFT — screenplay-beat layer; downstream artifacts (shot list, dialogue master, prompts) derive from this. NOT accepted/production-ready.
basedOn: F10_FROZEN scene heads + role-reassignment-audit + decision record (B)

legend.females: ASTRID/MERYT only; both must be non-decisive

scenes.head: NORTH SEA — STORM — NIGHT
scenes.beat: SŌLFARI beam-on to a hill-high black wave; BJÖRN hauls the steering-oar by main strength while ASTRID shouts the reads; the crest UNRAVELS into a seam of gold light and takes the ship.
scenes.bjornBeat: introduced: a giant who trusts muscle; lashed near the mast he is useless against the sea — first seed of his deep-water dread.
scenes.continuity: Himinkljúfr strapped to his back; crew soaked; Olaf grey/failing

scenes.head: SŌLFARI DECK
scenes.beat: after the crossing, the crew takes stock on a wrong-coloured sea.
scenes.bjornBeat: deadpan under impossible odds
scenes.comedy: TOVE's gallows humour vs BJÖRN's one-word replies

scenes.head: NORTH SEA — THE SEAM
scenes.beat: the ship is driven through; for a beat two worlds stack (storm above, desert below).
scenes.bjornBeat: he tries to cut their way free — the sword does nothing to light/water (planted flaw)

scenes.head: IMPOSSIBLE SHORE — DAWN OF TWO SUNS
scenes.beat: crew thrown onto wet sand under two suns; Olaf, failing, names what none understand.
scenes.bjornBeat: defers to Olaf (kinsman/captain) — leadership handoff begins

scenes.head: SHORE — THE PATROL
scenes.beat: an Egyptian river-patrol (MERYT on the ground) takes the strangers; IPU (a boy, water-jug) watches.
scenes.continuity: MERYT river-guard harness; IPU re-gendered boy

scenes.head: SHORE — THE FIRST TIDE
scenes.beat: a sudden wrong-tide surges; ASTRID senses it and calls; BJÖRN bodily hauls IPU and a guard clear as the water takes the strand.
scenes.bjornBeat: first muscle+mind beat — he ACTS on her read though he doesn't understand it; grudging first trust
scenes.mysteryRung: the tides here are 'wrong' (the bleed begins)

scenes.head: SHORE — SETH-NAKHT ARRIVES
scenes.beat: the commander claims the strangers and the strand; a cold standoff, no battle yet.
scenes.bjornBeat: BJÖRN sizes up SETH-NAKHT; restrained (rage held)

scenes.head: RIVER-TOWN — THE SAME EVENING
scenes.beat: the town after a tide; the WIDOWER (old man) keeps a drowned neighbour's place at a dry fountain.
scenes.mysteryRung: the human cost of the bleed, quietly

scenes.head: GARRISON — COUNCIL
scenes.beat: the garrison council; Seth-Nakht frames the strangers as the omen's cause.

scenes.head: GARRISON — HOLDING YARD / NEFER-KA
scenes.beat: NEFER-KA the reader-elder studies the captives; sees something in the Norse.
scenes.bjornBeat: BJÖRN scorns 'reading' as priest-talk — sets up his arc
scenes.comedy: BJÖRN: 'I read men by how they fall.' — deadpan
scenes.mysteryRung: a reader exists; the Guardian's wall is near

scenes.head: GARRISON — THE GUARDIAN'S WALL
scenes.beat: the wall records the rule of the tear; Nefer-Ka begins to explain.
scenes.bjornBeat: BJÖRN listens despite himself
scenes.mysteryRung: THE RULE seeded: the tear, the debt

scenes.head: GARRISON — SETH-NAKHT, NEFER-KA, MERYT
scenes.beat: Seth-Nakht sets his terms; Nefer-Ka warns; Meryt silent, guilty.
scenes.mysteryRung: the debt must be repaid or both ages bleed

scenes.head: GARRISON — THE CREW
scenes.beat: the Norse crew, caged, plan; BÖRK cooks from nothing; morale beat.
scenes.bjornBeat: a flash of the FEARED rage when VIGGE is threatened — he checks it, barely (flaw shown)
scenes.comedy: BJÖRN × BÖRK: warrior vs cook, 'you can't eat a sword' — running gag starts; greatsword won't fit the cell

scenes.head: GARRISON — OLAF & ASTRID (now OLAF & BJÖRN)
scenes.beat: Olaf, fading, formally hands the crew to BJÖRN; tells him strength won't be enough here and to heed the girl who reads the water.
scenes.bjornBeat: accepts the burden; distrusts the advice — the arc's thesis stated

scenes.head: GARRISON — SETH-NAKHT'S TERMS
scenes.beat: the bargain: the Norse help reach the seam-root or the town drowns; Björn forced to cooperate.
scenes.bjornBeat: swallows pride; tactical patience

scenes.head: DESERT — THE LESSON, AND A FAILURE
scenes.beat: ASTRID/NEFER-KA try to teach BJÖRN to read the ground; he fails badly and a feint-tide nearly drowns a man.
scenes.bjornBeat: humbled — strength useless; first real attempt to LEARN (arc engine)
scenes.comedy: BJÖRN mis-reads, bellows at the sand as if it will obey; it doesn't
scenes.continuity: deep-water dread flickers near the surge

scenes.head: DESERT — HE LEARNS
scenes.beat: BJÖRN gets ONE read right — small, hard-won.
scenes.bjornBeat: the turn: he starts to respect the mind over the arm

scenes.head: RIVER-TOWN — THE JOINT EVACUATION
scenes.beat: Norse + Egyptians evacuate ahead of a tide; BJÖRN is the physical engine (hauling beams, breaking a jam) timed to ASTRID's reads.
scenes.bjornBeat: muscle+mind fused; first public proof of the alliance
scenes.comedy: BÖRK insists on saving the stew-pot

scenes.head: GARRISON COURTYARD — ONE BAND
scenes.beat: two crews become one band under Björn.
scenes.bjornBeat: leadership consolidated
scenes.comedy: culture-clash banter Norse vs Egyptian drill

scenes.head: GARRISON — TOVE & BJÖRN
scenes.beat: quiet two-hander; Tove needles Björn about trusting the reader-girl.
scenes.bjornBeat: admits (to Tove only) he's afraid the sword won't save them here

scenes.head: RIVER-TOWN MARKET — DAY
scenes.beat: sets the market + geography for the second tide.
scenes.bjornBeat: scouts exits like a soldier
scenes.comedy: greatsword knocks over a fruit stall; vendor furious; running gag

scenes.head: MARKET — THE SECOND TIDE & SETH-NAKHT
scenes.beat: tide walks up the paving; ASTRID reads the safe row, BJÖRN clears the panicking crowd through it and holds a collapsing arch on his back; Seth-Nakht claims the credit.
scenes.bjornBeat: hero set-piece — strength serving the read; antagonist friction
scenes.continuity: Björn soaked; greatsword planted as a brace

scenes.head: MARKET — BJÖRN OUTMANEUVERS HIM
scenes.beat: Björn publicly refuses Seth-Nakht's framing without a blow — a social win.
scenes.bjornBeat: learns leverage beyond force

scenes.head: RIVER-TOWN EDGE — THE BLEED DEEPENS
scenes.beat: an uncanny leak — a thing from the wrong age appears; the clock tightens.
scenes.bjornBeat: he can read enough now to see it's accelerating

scenes.head: THE TWO TOWNS — NIGHTS OF THE BLEED
scenes.beat: wordless montage of the leak across two towns; dread + scale.
scenes.bjornBeat: carries Olaf, weaker now
scenes.continuity: lock one style plate across montage

scenes.head: GARRISON — THE SEIZURE
scenes.beat: Seth-Nakht seizes leverage (hostage/Olaf) to force the march.
scenes.bjornBeat: rage checked again — chooses the long game

scenes.head: GARRISON — BJÖRN & MERYT
scenes.beat: Björn and Meryt, wary allies, find common ground (both have lost someone to water).
scenes.bjornBeat: empathy; his dread named obliquely

scenes.head: MERYT'S BROTHER
scenes.beat: MERYT confesses the cause — the forbidden double dawn-rite grieving her drowned brother; BJÖRN, hearing it, DECIDES not to condemn her (his growth).
scenes.bjornBeat: hears the human cause; does not condemn (growth)
scenes.mysteryRung: THE CAUSE revealed (grief opened the door)

scenes.head: CAMP, CANYON MOUTH — HELGI & BJÖRN
scenes.beat: HELGI gives Björn the two-kinds-of-choosing speech (duty vs chosen) using the carved horse.
scenes.bjornBeat: the thematic key for his climax — choose, don't just obey/fight

scenes.head: DESERT CANYON — DUSK
scenes.beat: canyon approach; a skirmish with Seth-Nakht's outriders — Björn's disciplined greatsword work (tactical, not berserk).
scenes.bjornBeat: combat signature matured: timed strikes, terrain use
scenes.comedy: Tove scores the fight like a bard

scenes.head: CANYON — THE ECHO
scenes.beat: the canyon echoes the readers; a mystery texture beat.
scenes.bjornBeat: he can now feel the read, faintly
scenes.mysteryRung: the seam-root is near; readers resonate

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT APPROACH — THE THIRD TIDE
scenes.beat: biggest tide yet; BJÖRN and the band cross a flooding causeway on ASTRID's reads; a near-loss.
scenes.bjornBeat: penultimate action — he nearly drowns (dread peaks), saved by trusting the read
scenes.mysteryRung: proximity to the seam-root amplifies everything
scenes.continuity: greatsword as anchor against the surge

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT APPROACH — AFTER
scenes.beat: the cost tallied; Olaf weaker; quiet before the end.
scenes.bjornBeat: accepts what's coming

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT CAMP — THE CONFESSION
scenes.beat: Seth-Nakht twists Meryt's guilt publicly to keep his leash.
scenes.bjornBeat: defends Meryt without a blow; undercuts Seth-Nakht

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT CAMP — IPU & MERYT
scenes.beat: tender beat — Meryt and the boy IPU; innocence at stake.

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT CAMP — THE TRAP CLEAR
scenes.beat: the plan set for the convergence; Nefer-Ka states the closing rule plainly.
scenes.bjornBeat: realizes what the rule will cost — and who can pay it
scenes.mysteryRung: THE RULE restated: a reader walks in, does not return

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — THE SUNS CONVERGING
scenes.beat: the two suns draw close; the clock hits zero; Björn takes command of the field.
scenes.bjornBeat: leader at the brink
scenes.mysteryRung: convergence — the door can be shut now
scenes.continuity: two-sun sky plate locked for III

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — BJÖRN TAKES THE FIELD
scenes.beat: Seth-Nakht charges a wedge to seize the seam; ASTRID reads the ground, BJÖRN breaks the charge — timing single sky-splitter strikes and planting the greatsword as the sand erupts to sea on her call; Seth-Nakht's authority collapses before his own men.
scenes.bjornBeat: the physical/decisive climax of Act III's battle — muscle fully fused with the read; NOT berserk, disciplined
scenes.continuity: CANON-CORRECTED: this is BJÖRN-decisive (Astrid reads). greatsword tracked; no gore

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — SETH-NAKHT'S CHOICE
scenes.beat: broken, Seth-Nakht chooses — turn on Björn or help shut the door; Björn gives him the chance (mercy as strength).
scenes.bjornBeat: offers the enemy a choice — growth beyond killing

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — THE COST OF THE LINE
scenes.beat: to buy the readers their window, the band holds the surging tides; BÖRK braces as a living dam so VIGGE lives — and drowns.
scenes.bjornBeat: BJÖRN cannot save Börk (his dread + the water win) — the loss that steels him for his own choice
scenes.comedy: a last Björn×Börk beat before the water takes him — comedy into grief
scenes.continuity: Börk apron; drowning not gore; Tove hauls Vigge in

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — TWO READERS
scenes.beat: the readers confirm: the door needs someone who can read it to walk in. ASTRID and NEFER-KA can — but BJÖRN reveals he has learned enough.
scenes.bjornBeat: the quiet decision forms — it will be him, not her

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — THE REFUSAL
scenes.beat: ASTRID/MERYT would go (guilt, duty); BJÖRN refuses to let either — he takes the debt himself.
scenes.bjornBeat: chooses (Helgi's lesson realized); shields the women from the sacrifice

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — OLAF
scenes.beat: Olaf dies (or departs) having seen Björn become more than a sword; a father's benediction.
scenes.bjornBeat: grief + resolve

scenes.head: SEAM-ROOT — TOVE'S GOODBYE
scenes.beat: Björn and Tove say it without saying it; the band's farewell to its leader.
scenes.bjornBeat: accepts he won't return
scenes.comedy: one last gallows joke that lands as love

scenes.head: SEAM / SHORE — THE CLOSE
scenes.beat: the seam opens to be shut; ASTRID reads the exact timing from outside; BJÖRN plants Himinkljúfr at the threshold, sets his hand from it, and steps in — his final decisive act is NOT a swing.
scenes.bjornBeat: faces his deep-water dread (the seam feels like drowning) and walks in by choice
scenes.mysteryRung: the door shuts only from within
scenes.continuity: greatsword LEFT planted at the threshold (prop payoff); two-sun plate

scenes.head: THE SEAM — THE MIDDLE
scenes.beat: inside the seam BJÖRN reads it shut from within; visions of Olaf/Helgi/his brother; he does not return.
scenes.bjornBeat: the sacrifice completed — comprehension costs him everything

scenes.head: SHORE — THE SUNS PART
scenes.beat: the two suns separate; the sky heals; ASTRID witnesses (aftermath event — no decisive agent).
scenes.bjornBeat: absent — gone
scenes.mysteryRung: the debt is paid; the world restored

scenes.head: THE CAIRN — SINGLE-SUN MORNING
scenes.beat: a cairn raised for BJÖRN, his greatsword set in the stones; the survivors grieve and honour him.
scenes.bjornBeat: his legend; the sword as monument

scenes.head: A BEND IN THE GREAT RIVER — SOME DAY
scenes.beat: epilogue: the boy IPU (now older) carries Björn's story forward; ASTRID (secondary) hands it on — a franchise-ready coda honouring Björn.
scenes.bjornBeat: remembered; legend seeds a sequel protagonist
scenes.comedy: a gentle callback to a Björn joke
